empty.purpose: Says there are no crates yet.
empty.where: Crates screen, in place of the crate list.

list.label.purpose: Names the list of crates for screen readers.
list.label.where: Crates screen, the list of crates (not shown).

trackCount_zero.purpose: Says a crate has no tracks.
trackCount_zero.where: Crates screen, next to a crate's name in the list.

trackCount_one.purpose: Says a crate has one track.
trackCount_one.where: Crates screen, next to a crate's name in the list.

trackCount_other.purpose: Says how many tracks a crate has.
trackCount_other.where: Crates screen, next to a crate's name in the list.

noTracks.purpose: Says the chosen crate has no tracks.
noTracks.where: Crates screen, right side, in place of the track list.

select.purpose: Asks the user to choose a crate to see its tracks.
select.where: Crates screen, right side, while no crate is chosen.

new.button.where: Crates screen, above the crate list.

new.label.purpose: Names the field for the new crate's name.

new.confirm.purpose: Makes the crate with the typed name.

new.cancel.purpose: Closes the new-crate form without making a crate.

rename.button.where: Crates screen, header of the chosen crate.

rename.label.purpose: Names the field for the crate's new name.

rename.confirm.purpose: Renames the crate to the typed name.

rename.cancel.purpose: Closes the rename form without renaming.

delete.button.where: Crates screen, header of the chosen crate.

delete.title.purpose: Asks whether to delete the chosen crate.

delete.detail.purpose: Says the delete can be undone.

removeTrack.button.purpose: Takes a track out of the chosen crate.
removeTrack.button.where: Crates screen, last cell of each track row.

removeTrack.buttonFor.purpose: Names the Remove button of one track for screen readers.
removeTrack.buttonFor.where: Crates screen, last cell of each track row (not shown).

addTrack.label.purpose: Offers the crates a Library track can be added to.
addTrack.label.where: Library screen, choice in the last cell of each track row.

addTrack.labelFor.purpose: Names one track's Add to crate choice for screen readers.
addTrack.labelFor.where: Library screen, each track row (not shown).

addTrack.none.purpose: Says there is no crate to add to.
addTrack.none.where: Library screen, the greyed-out choice in each track row when there are no crates.

addTrack.added.purpose: Says the track was added to the crate.
addTrack.added.where: Library screen, status strip above the list after an add.

addTrack.alreadyIn.purpose: Says the track was already in the crate, so nothing changed.
addTrack.alreadyIn.where: Library screen, status strip above the list after an add.

done.created.where: Crates screen, status strip with Undo.

done.renamed.where: Crates screen, status strip with Undo.

done.deleted.where: Crates screen, status strip with Undo.

done.removed.purpose: Says the track was taken out of the crate.
done.removed.where: Crates screen, status strip with Undo.

undo.where: Crates and Library screens, status strip after a crate change.

undone.purpose: Says the last change was undone.
undone.where: Crates and Library screens, status strip after an undo.

undoRefused.purpose: Says the undo was refused because the Library changed since.
undoRefused.where: Crates and Library screens, after an undo that was refused.
undoRefused.approved: Can't undo: the Library has changed since

error.notFound.where: Any crate action on a crate that is gone.

error.nameEmpty.purpose: Says the crate's name was empty.
error.nameEmpty.where: Crates screen, new-crate and rename forms.

error.nameTaken.purpose: Says another crate already has the name.
error.nameTaken.where: Crates screen, new-crate and rename forms.

error.nameUnsendable.purpose: Says the name has a character rekordbox can't take.
error.nameUnsendable.where: Crates screen, new-crate and rename forms.
error.nameUnsendable.approved: Name has a character that can't be sent to rekordbox. Remove it and try again.
